text:
What Are Deductibles? 
Simple Meaning:
• A deductible is the amount the insured 
must absorb before insurance starts 
paying.
Why it matters in CAT Modeling:
• Deductibles change how much loss 
attaches to the model.
• They can be flat amounts or 
percentage based.
• They vary by location, peril, region, 
occupancy, etc.
